title: China’s Alibaba joins stablecoin platform MetaComp’s $35M fundraise
summary: MetaComp’s Pre-A+ funding round, backed by Alibaba and Spark Venture, brings the total capital raised to $35 million, with aims to expand its StableX Network globally.

title: Bitcoin's 'extremely precise' macro signal puts $100K target back in play
summary: US and China's yield crossover amid whale buying suggest Bitcoin may be close to a price bottom, setting up for a move toward six figures in the coming months.

title: Vitalik distances himself from nonprofit backed by SHIB donation
summary: Vitalik Buterin said he is no longer closely aligned with the Future of Life Institute after its strategy shifted following his 2021 SHIB donation.

title: Crypto miners must put their Bitcoin to work to survive: Wintermute
summary: Miners who treat their Bitcoin holdings as a working asset rather than a passive reserve “will carry a structural edge into the next halving,” says Wintermute.

title: Bitcoin advocate group to fight Basel’s ‘toxic’ treatment of cryptocurrency
summary: The Bitcoin Policy Institute wants to ensure “US regulators get Bitcoin’s treatment right” when the Federal Reserve issues proposals to implement the Basel framework.

title: Eightco lands $125M from Bitmine, ARK as Tom Lee joins board
summary: The fresh capital from Kraken’s parent company, Ark Invest, and Bitmine has backed Eightco’s new bets on OpenAI and MrBeast

title: Democrats say they will oversee reported DOJ probe into Binance
summary: Senators Chris Van Hollen, Elizabeth Warren and Ruben Gallego have vowed to ensure that the Justice Department “conducts a serious investigation into Binance.”

title: MEV bot makes $10M in $50M crypto swap gone wrong
summary: Aave founder Stani Kulechov says a user confirmed a warning to proceed with the swap, despite “extraordinary slippage,” while a MEV bot also attacked the large transaction.

title: US Treasury sanctions enablers of North Korea IT worker fraud ring
summary: Fraudulent tech workers with ties to North Korea target a range of industries, including blockchain companies, with schemes and infrastructure spreading worldwide.

title: Trump offers memecoin holders another gala to boost token from lows
summary: Donald Trump is billed as the keynote speaker at an event in Florida for his top memecoin holders, which comes as the token hits an all-time low.
